reuse.why: Routes the flag through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked check used by every provider, but re-writes unlinkAccount's local field reset instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: The block of nulled sync fields is a verbatim copy of the update inside unlinkAccount, and the flag is threaded by hand through six provider functions that each repeat the same call.

placement.why: The unlink write is placed inside a function named and used as an assertion, so a guard now silently mutates another account; it would belong in the link flow or a named unlink-local helper.

scope.why: Only the flag, its handling and a test are added; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: A mutating 'assert' and a second copy of the unlink field list will drift from unlinkAccount and surprise readers; otherwise the change is small and clear.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked clears account_id/bank/balances/sync source itself instead of going through a shared local part of unlinkAccount (comment explains unlinkAccount would contact providers, but the local reset was not factored out).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied db.updateAccount field list is an open copy of unlinkAccount's, not renamed or reshaped.
